select team, count(*) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER group by 1
select call_typ, count(*), max(call_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT group by 1
select p.*, m.mkt_def, m.eff_from, m.eff_to from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p left join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on p.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 order by 1

select r.prod_ndc11, length(r.prod_ndc11) l, m.mkt_def, count(*), sum(trx_qty), min(wk_end_dt), max(wk_end_dt), count(distinct wk_end_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r left join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 group by 1,2,3 order by 1
select dayname(wk_end_dt) d, count(distinct wk_end_dt), min(wk_end_dt), max(wk_end_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY group by 1

with v as (select r.prscrbr_me, sum(iff(m.mkt_def='DRY_EYE',trx_qty,0)) de, sum(iff(m.mkt_def='GLAUCOMA',trx_qty,0)) gl, sum(trx_qty) tot from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 group by 1)
select p.decile, count(*), count(v.prscrbr_me), min(de), avg(de), max(de), min(gl), avg(gl), max(gl), avg(tot) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join v on p.prscrbr_me=v.prscrbr_me group by 1 order by 1

with v as (select r.prscrbr_me, sum(iff(m.mkt_def='DRY_EYE',trx_qty,0)) de, sum(iff(m.mkt_def='GLAUCOMA',trx_qty,0)) gl, max(wk_end_dt) last_wk from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 group by 1)
select p.*, v.de, v.gl, v.last_wk from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join v on p.prscrbr_me=v.prscrbr_me where p.decile>=8 and coalesce(v.de,0)<850 order by decile

select table_schema, table_name, column_name, comment from PHARMA_DEMO.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where comment is not null or column_name ilike any ('%PDRP%','%OPT%','%RESTR%','%FLG%','%CONSENT%','%NO_SEE%','%STATE%') order by 1,2

with v as (select p.prscrbr_me, p.decile, coalesce(sum(iff(m.mkt_def='DRY_EYE',r.trx_qty,0)),0) de
 from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r on p.prscrbr_me=r.prscrbr_me left join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 group by 1,2),
c as (select *, sum(de) over (order by de asc, prscrbr_me rows unbounded preceding)/sum(de) over () cum, ntile(10) over (order by de) nt from v)
select decile, least(10, ceil(cum*10)) vol_dec, count(*), min(de), max(de) from c where decile>=7 or ceil(cum*10)>=8 group by 1,2 order by 1,2

with de as (select r.prscrbr_me, sum(r.trx_qty) de_trx_52w,
   sum(iff(r.wk_end_dt > dateadd(week,-13,'2026-09-25'::date), r.trx_qty,0)) de_trx_13w,
   sum(iff(r.wk_end_dt > dateadd(week,-13,'2026-09-25'::date) and r.prod_ndc11 in ('99101010105','99101010110'), r.trx_qty,0)) lacrivia_13w
  from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 and m.mkt_def='DRY_EYE' group by 1),
c as (select c.prscrbr_me, max(c.call_dt) last_call_any,
   max(iff(c.call_dt >= '2026-07-02', c.call_dt, null)) last_call_90,
   count_if(c.call_dt >= '2026-07-02') calls_90,
   count_if(c.call_dt >= '2026-07-02' and c.call_typ<>'VIRTUAL') inperson_90,
   listagg(distinct iff(c.call_dt >= '2026-07-02', r.team, null), ',') teams_90
  from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r on c.rep_id=r.rep_id group by 1),
cp as (select prscrbr_me, listagg(distinct rep_id||':'||target_typ, ',') plan_q3 from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_PLAN where fqtr='2026Q3' group by 1)
select p.prscrbr_me, p.npi, p.prscrbr_nm, p.spclty, p.decile, p.terr_id, t.district_id, a.account_nm, de.de_trx_52w, de.de_trx_13w, de.lacrivia_13w, c.last_call_any, coalesce(c.calls_90,0) calls_90, c.inperson_90, c.teams_90, cp.plan_q3
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join de on p.prscrbr_me=de.prscrbr_me left join c on p.prscrbr_me=c.prscrbr_me
left join cp on p.prscrbr_me=cp.prscrbr_me left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t on p.terr_id=t.terr_id left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.ACCOUNT a on p.account_id=a.account_id
where p.decile>=8 and (coalesce(c.calls_90,0)=0 or c.inperson_90=0)
order by p.decile desc, de.de_trx_13w desc nulls last

with c as (select prscrbr_me, count_if(call_dt >= '2026-07-02') n90, count_if(call_dt >= '2026-07-03') n90s from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT group by 1)
select p.decile, count(*) hcps, count_if(coalesce(n90,0)=0) uncalled_91d, count_if(coalesce(n90s,0)=0) uncalled_90d_strict,
 count_if(p.prscrbr_me in ('ME7000934442','ME7001504610','ME7002621189','ME7001734261') and coalesce(n90,0)=0) zero_de_uncalled
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join c on p.prscrbr_me=c.prscrbr_me where p.decile>=8 group by 1 order by 1 desc

with de as (select r.prscrbr_me, sum(iff(r.wk_end_dt > dateadd(week,-13,'2026-09-25'::date), r.trx_qty,0)) de_trx_13w
  from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 and m.mkt_def='DRY_EYE' group by 1),
c as (select c.prscrbr_me, max(c.call_dt) last_call, count_if(c.call_dt >= '2026-07-03') n90, count_if(c.call_dt >= '2026-07-03' and call_typ<>'VIRTUAL') ip90,
  max_by(r.team||' '||c.call_typ, c.call_dt) last_call_desc
  from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r on c.rep_id=r.rep_id group by 1)
select p.prscrbr_nm, p.npi, p.decile, p.terr_id, de.de_trx_13w, c.last_call, c.last_call_desc, n90, ip90
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join de on p.prscrbr_me=de.prscrbr_me left join c on p.prscrbr_me=c.prscrbr_me
where p.decile>=8 and (c.last_call between '2026-07-01' and '2026-07-03' or (n90>0 and ip90=0))
order by decile desc
